title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
core_contribution: RAG 开山之作:seq2seq 参数记忆 + 稠密向量索引非参数记忆,提出 RAG-Sequence 与 RAG-Token 两种条件方式
limitation: 依赖检索质量;dense index 更新成本高

title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
core_contribution: 纯稠密检索 top-20 acc 超 Lucene-BM25 9%-19%;双编码器 + in-batch negative 训练
limitation: 需要标注问答对;域外泛化未知

title: Precise Zero-Shot Dense Retrieval without Relevance Labels
core_contribution: HyDE:指令 LLM 生成假设文档后由无监督对比编码器编码
limitation: 靠向量邻域召回真实文档;无需相关性标签
zotero_key: 依赖 LLM 生成质量;假设文档可能含虚假细节

title: ColBERT: Efficient and Effective Passage Search via Contextualized Late Interaction over BERT
core_contribution: 晚交互:query/doc 独立 BERT 编码后做细粒度相似度;doc 表示可离线预计算
limitation: 支持向量索引端到端检索
zotero_key: 存储开销大(doc 逐 token 向量)

title: Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation
core_contribution: 轻量检索评估器给置信度 → 触发 Correct/Incorrect/Ambiguous 动作;web 检索扩展 + decompose-then-recompose 过滤噪声
limitation: 依赖检索评估器质量;web 检索引入外部依赖

title: Leveraging Passage Retrieval with Generative Models for Open Domain Question Answering
limitation: FiD:每个 passage 独立编码后融合解码;Top-K 越大越好
zotero_key: 证据:生成模型擅长聚合多证据
arxiv_id: 计算量随 Top-K 增长

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models: A Survey
limitation: Naive/Advanced/Modular RAG 演进;检索/生成/增强三部件 SOTA;评估框架与基准
column12: 全景定位+hybrid 实践支撑

title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
core_contribution: 相关证据在上下文中间时性能显著下降
limitation: 首尾最好 → 直接启示 RAG 上下文排序与 Top-K 取舍
arxiv_id: 无修复方案;仅短答案任务

title: Evaluating Verifiability in Generative Search Engines
dataset: 4 个生成式搜索系统查询集
core_contribution: 引用 recall(所有语句被引用支撑)+ precision(每个引用支持其语句)两层标准;平均仅 51.5% 句子完全被支撑、74.5% 引用支持对应句
limitation: 人类评估成本高;商业系统黑盒
notes: 北极星指标(引用正确率)理论基

title: Ragas: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation
core_contribution: reference-free 指标套件:faithfulness / 答案相关性 / 上下文相关性与召回;无需金标准标注

title: CRUD-RAG: A Comprehensive Chinese Benchmark for Retrieval-Augmented Generation of Large Language Models
core_contribution: Create/Read/Update/Delete 四类 RAG 场景;评估检索器/上下文长度/知识库/LLM 各组件影响
limitation: 中文语料;部分场景(写/改/删)与可溯源问答关系弱
notes: 中文基准;全组件评估视角

title: Benchmarking Large Language Models in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
core_contribution: 4 能力维度:noise robustness / negative rejection / information integration / counterfactual robustness;发现 LLM 拒答与信息整合显著偏弱
limitation: 测试集规模有限;聚焦能力诊断
notes: negative rejection 维度直接对应拒答率指标
